supported_surfaces.coverage: Lean model for accepted proof metadata binding, TEE/recursive/zkVM field discipline, and digest uniqueness under an explicit injectivity assumption.

Risc0 spot-transition proof envelope to ZenoLedger proof metadata, including header binding, optional verifier-command acceptance, optional proof app-hash to header state-root checks, and metadata binding for ingress, nonce, and accepted-receipt roots.
Rust shared transition and Python spot fixtures agree for CPMM pool-id hashing, create-pool, faucet mint, swap-exact-in, add-liquidity, and remove-liquidity fixture semantics.

Opt-in real Risc0 proof smoke for empty transition plus faucet mint, create-pool, swap-exact-in, add-liquidity, remove-liquidity, and one multi-transaction spot liquidity-cycle block over the supported spot v1 operation families, with guest nonce sequencing, accepted-receipt roots, and emitted ZenoLedger body/header/proof-metadata bindings checked by the archive checker.

Strict ZenoLedger range verification anchors a canonical pre-state snapshot, binds a float-free governed engine configuration, carries replayed state across linked headers, executes each supported transaction body exactly once, and requires exact post-state roots and rejection receipts. V0 rejects nonempty body-level settlement_envelopes because it has no governed executor for that effect surface. Structural diagnostics cannot authorize watcher attestations.

Metadata-only diagnostic coverage: ZenoLedger requires header-bound proof metadata per checked height when the active profile or bridge policy requires proof journals. This surface does not satisfy cryptographic proof authority and proof-required replay fails closed at the typed consumer obligation.
ZenoLedger range verifier can require per-height proof-verification reports that match header-bound proof metadata.

Local light-client checkpoint verifier binds a structural header/body/checkpoint diagnostic to a signer-registry signature-set root and BLS checkpoint quorum; deterministic state-transition replay remains a gap.

gap_surfaces.required_for: Cryptographic proof_required and proof-journal bridge authority
gap_surfaces.gap: The typed final-consumer port rejects caller booleans and records a pending obligation. The V0 replay configuration still does not consensus-bind the authority-manifest digest, verifier-registry identity, and strict private authenticated result. A cycle-free replay_engine_config/v1 must commit the complete governed proof-authority policy before proof_authority_satisfied can become true.
No real zkVM proof currently covers UPBA v2/v3 batch clearing, exact-out, or candidate-grid optimality.
No real zkVM proof currently covers ZenoOracle critical-action packets or oracle truth/governance assumptions.
No real zkVM proof currently covers zUSD mint, liquidation, recovery, or supply-conservation lifecycle transitions.
No real zkVM proof currently covers perps settlement, liquidation, ADL, funding, or insurance transitions.
No real zkVM proof currently covers proof-mining manager rewards, claimability, or reward payout bridge execution.
The local light-client checkpoint lane consumes a structural range diagnostic and does not yet carry governed pre-state snapshots and engine configuration through deterministic state replay.

Local checkpoint quorum replay now binds one verified chain segment to a signer registry and BLS quorum, but production validator rotation, fork-choice, slashing, peer discovery, and adversarial network finality remain out of scope.
Recursive proof metadata fields are modeled and validated, but no real recursive epoch receipt aggregation is implemented.
